messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: affine image of a projective configuration avoiding collinearity

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square, maximizing the minimum area over all 286 triangles, is the affine image of the projective completion of the regular 13-gon embedded in the projective plane and clipped to the square, achieving a minimum triangle area of at least 1/200. The projective symmetry of the 13-gon eliminates collinear triples entirely, and the affine map to the square can be chosen to maximize the minimum image area."}
